description: This file defines an enumeration 'OpenClawBonjour' that manages constants and functions related to Bonjour service domains, including domain normalization and resolution logic.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the wide area domain from a raw string, returning nil if invalid or the domain is the default gateway service domain.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a raw domain string by trimming, lowercasing, and ensuring proper suffix, defaulting to the gateway service domain if input is empty or local.
